title: How retailers can win over today’s consumer

facts.fact: According to Google, U.S. impulse buys dropped from 30% to 26% in the year before the page's September 2025 update, as consumers did more research.
facts.quote: U.S. impulse buys dropped from 30% to 26% last year

facts.fact: Google states that it handles more than 5 trillion searches every year.
facts.quote: With more than 5 trillion searches every year

facts.fact: Google states that over 60% of shopping queries now focus on broad intent, using conversational phrases.
facts.quote: over 60% of shopping queries now focus on broad intent

facts.fact: Google describes the holiday season as a three-month event, with consumers pacing purchases from October to the New Year.
facts.quote: cemented the holiday season as a three month event

facts.fact: The page was last updated on September 11, 2025.
